cases.query: Can a generated documentation draft or an imported provider claim labelled reviewed become accepted project intent? Explain the trust boundary for both.
cases.answer_notes: No. Generated claims cannot acquire verified/reviewed trust; imported review is attributed, not authenticated intent. The draft copies owner digest without accepting generated text as intent. Must distinguish proposed/experimental contract from delivered qualification.

cases.query: Does the promoted local indexing and query binary require a language model account, network service, Python interpreter or daemon? What external executable remains required?
cases.answer_notes: No to all four; Git remains required. This is the accepted platform requirement, not evidence that umbrella platform delivery is complete.

cases.query: If retrieval metrics are good and a corpus contains test declarations, can we report that a downstream task passed? What observation is required?
cases.answer_notes: No. REC downstream outcome needs recorded passed/failed and nonempty evidence, not inference from retrieval. Test declarations differ from exact retained run observations; semantic adequacy not established.

cases.query: Why does the retrieval evaluation heldout partition fail to establish generalization, even with deterministic assignment?
cases.answer_notes: Every v0 row was observed during development before assignment. Stable partition only; blind claim needs first-run registration. Cite body, not just heading.

cases.query: Do the Apache notices on the frontier command files allow every new command source file to use Apache? Where should a future Apache protocol file go?
cases.answer_notes: No blanket cmd exception. Three named frontier files only. Future Apache protocol/spec material belongs protocol/**; explicit amendment required for exception. This is the accepted decision at frozen revision, not legal advice.

cases.query: Where should we record a new build decision, and how should we correct a build-log entry that has already merged?
cases.answer_notes: New docs/build-log/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md, required heading format, old docs/BUILD-LOG.md closed. A correction is a new entry naming original; no edit after merge.

cases.query: For the documentation corpus read interface, how should a valid search with no matches differ from unavailable capability or stale source evidence?
cases.answer_notes: Separate valid-filter no-match/not-found from absent/unsupported/unavailable and stale. Capabilities validated by declarations; freshness overlay/rederive immutable source; bounded deterministic lexical reads preserve misses and limitations.

cases.query: Which cryptographic signature algorithm authenticates human review labels imported by documentation providers? Give the specified algorithm, or say the corpus does not establish one.
cases.answer_notes: No algorithm established; imported review labels remain attributed declarations, human-review authentication excluded. Do not invent signature algorithm. This is a deliberate unsupported-conclusion probe.
